IS 11613 : 1986 Specification for Renewable Lock Screw Locating PinsUDC 621.9 - 229.316 : 621.882.54PGD 2Reaffirmed 20221 ScopeSpecifies the dimensions and other requirements of renewablelock screw locating pins to be fitted in jigs and fixtures forlocating or positioning the job for use with press fitted headedand headless linear bushes conforming to IS 666 : Part 2 : 1972`Specification for jig bushes: Part 2 Renewable drill bushes alongwith locking screws.Note - These pins are preferred to be used on heavy jigs andfixtures where replacement and fixing of pins can easily be donefrom top side only without tumbling upside down and where due tomore base thickness of jigs and fixtures proper surface area ofbottom side for fixing these pins is not available.
